description.value: Mt. Begbie Brewery is an award-winning craft brewery that has been operating in Revelstoke, BC since 1996, making it one of the longest-running independent craft breweries in the province. The brewery features a tasting room and a retail store where cyclists can pick up packaged beer to go, alongside a food menu. Revelstoke's position as a gateway to mountain recreation makes this a natural stop for touring cyclists passing through town.
